replay.harness: .github/workflows/test.yml at base commit, step Run adaptive interleaved benchmark samples
replay.prepare: Materialize Git archive twice and overlay only candidateFiles on head. Verify SHA-256 and add the shared fixture to both checkouts. Use scripts/setup-modules.sh per checkout, then base scripts/benchrun compile for each pkg/codegen.
replay.compilerFlags: Go 1.27.1 native, -trimpath, default linker, identical native Go/CGO settings on both arms; unset GOFLAGS and additional linker overrides.
replay.timing: Use an isolated native runner and the existing AB/BA workflow loop with 10 pairs and -test.benchmem -test.benchtime=200ms -test.cpu=2. Preserve independent confirmation for a flagged primary. Keep A/A same runner if diagnosing noisy default layout.
replay.gate: Existing benchplan --normalize and --verify, pinned benchstat alpha .01, existing benchgate with the exact baseline. Preserve ns/op, B/op and allocs/op and per-leaf diagnostics. No cost approval inherited.
replay.outcomeDifference: Interpret changed rows as compiler work for restored correctness. They do not cancel other costs. Full Generate of the leading-discard case is a correctness test only since the baseline exits with a Go formatting error.
